decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [HOU113/24/04 Location plan, HOU113/24/04 existing elevations, HOU113/24/02, HOU113/24/03, HOU113/24/07. Received: 13/10/2025. HOU113/24/09 Rev A, HOU113/24/08 Rev A, HOU113/24/01. Received: 23/12/2025.
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The ground floor premises and external seating area shall be used only as a mixed bar/public house and restaurant, falling within Sui Generis and Class E(b) and for no other purpose including any other purpose within Class E or Sui Generis of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), nor in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Reason: The Council is satisfied that the use hereby permitted would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use within the same Use Class to protect nearby land uses and the character of the area.

Condition : 7 - All refuse and recycling bins, delivery cages, trolleys or any other items linked to deliveries and collection in association with the approved development are to be stored within the building(s) at all times and only brought out onto the public highway when deliveries are being made or refuse collected.
Reason: To protect the quality of the local environment and to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the public highway.
description: Replacement of the existing shopfront, relocation of the existing flue, and installation of a foldable canopy to the rear of the premises, to allow the change of use from an existing bar/pub (Sui Generis) to a mixed bar/pub and restaurant use (Sui Generis/Class E(b))
